name: Plate demon
description: a hulking basalt demon of the Cracked Road holding a huge slab of dark iron plate in front of its body like a wall, glowing orange cracks in its skin behind the plate, small horned head peeking over the top

poses.stand: standing behind the big iron plate held out in front, glowing cracks in the grey skin, facing right
poses.struck: struck: the plate rings and sparks, the demon flinching behind it
poses.dead: collapsed in a heap, the dropped plate split and glowing

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
